sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Reject: applicability remains over-broad. The structuralMember alternative applies to every structuralMember, but the requirement is limited to shell plating or local-frame hull structures governed by I2.4, I2.6, or I2.7. Add a canonical applicability/governing-section term or path that distinguishes those local-frame structures and encode the restriction; do not treat generic structuralMember as sufficient. Preserve the existing ship→calculationCase→hullStructure paths, thickness on the hullStructure owner with the declared metre unit, prescribedAnalyticalProcedure requirement, and exclusion of directCalculationMethodValue.
